download.title: Obli.tools
download.description:
A lightweight native interface that groups all your Obli apps into one window.
Get sound notifications and a distraction-free monitoring experience.
download.buildFromSourceDesc: The desktop app lives in the desktop-app/ directory of the Obliview repository.
download.step1: On first launch, enter the URL of your Obli server (Obliguard, Obliview, Oblimap or Obliance). Linked apps are discovered automatically.
download.step2: Each app opens in its own native tab — no browser overhead, no address bar, sessions are preserved when switching tabs.
download.step3: Sound notifications play on new alerts, such as an attack or an agent going offline.
download.step4: Click the ⚙ gear icon (bottom-right corner) to change the server URL at any time.
download.step5: No rebuild is needed after Obliguard updates — the app always loads the latest web UI.
download.pageDescription: The Obli.tools desktop app and the Obliguard agent builds served by this server.
